title: proMCP do_* response
description: Response contract for all do_* tools in a proMCP-compliant MCP server. Mutation tools must declare idempotency, compensation, and side effects. The idempotency_key enables safe retry. The compensable field gates rollback capability.

status.description: Outcome of the mutation. 'success': fully applied, all side_effects committed. 'partial': partially applied, side_effects list reflects what was committed. 'failed': not applied, no side effects committed.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key identifying this specific execution. The server must return the same status and applied_value for duplicate calls with the same key within the deduplication window (recommended minimum: 24 hours). Clients must reuse this key on retry.

applied_value.description: The value that was actually applied by this mutation. Required when the operation sets a measurable value. NULL for non-value mutations (deletes, triggers). Must reflect the actual applied value, not the requested value — these differ when clamping or rounding occurs.

previous_value.description: The value that existed before this mutation. Required when applied_value is present. Enables the orchestrator to construct the compensation call without a prior read_*.

side_effects.description: Declared list of side effects produced by this mutation. Each entry is a human-readable string identifying an observable external change. Examples: 'stock_level_change', 'audit_log_entry', 'email_notification_sent', 'zone_3_climate_change'.

compensable.description: Whether this mutation can be reversed by a subsequent tool call. When true, compensation_hint is required. When false and status is 'failed' after partial side effects in a workflow, the orchestrator MUST escalate to human review.

compensation_hint.description: Required when compensable is true. Machine-readable description of the tool call needed to reverse this mutation. Recommended format: '{tool_name} {param}={value}'. Example: 'do_transfer_stock sku=SKU-001 quantity=50 source_warehouse=B destination_warehouse=A'.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 datetime at which the mutation was applied (or attempted).
